user.title: WhatsApp app
user.description: Home Assistant will detect the local WhatsApp app automatically. Start the app and submit again if it is not detected yet. For decrypted incoming attachments, update both components to 2.0.0 or newer and enable Download incoming media in the app.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WhatsApp app
reconfigure.description: Home Assistant will rediscover the local WhatsApp app automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not detect a running WhatsApp app.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not detect a running WhatsApp app.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a WhatsApp message through the configured app.

to.name: Target
to.description: The WhatsApp phone, LID, group, or broadcast JID to receive the message.

body.name: Body
body.description: The message payload accepted by the WhatsApp app.

options.name: Options
options.description: Optional Baileys send options, such as quoted message data.

check_number.name: Check number
check_number.description: Checks whether one phone number is registered with WhatsApp.

to.name: Phone number
to.description: An international phone number, optionally prefixed with +, or its @s.whatsapp.net JID.

get_group_info.name: Get group info
get_group_info.description: Returns the name, description, owner, settings, and participants of a WhatsApp group the linked account belongs to.

to.name: Group
to.description: The WhatsApp group @g.us JID, for example the key.remoteJid of a received group message.

set_status.name: Set status
set_status.description: Sets the WhatsApp account status message.

presence_subscribe.name: Subscribe to presence
presence_subscribe.description: Subscribes to WhatsApp presence updates for a contact.

send_presence_update.name: Send presence update
send_presence_update.description: Sends a one-shot WhatsApp presence update.

to.name: Target
to.description: An optional WhatsApp phone or LID JID.

send_infinity_presence_update.name: Send long-running presence update
send_infinity_presence_update.description: Sends a long-running WhatsApp presence update.

to.name: Target
to.description: An optional WhatsApp phone or LID JID.

read_messages.name: Mark messages as read
read_messages.description: Marks one or more received WhatsApp messages as read.

body.name: Body
body.description: An object containing the Baileys message key under keys.

get_profile.name: Get profile
get_profile.description: Returns the profile picture URL, about text, and business profile of a WhatsApp contact, or the picture of a group.

to.name: Contact or group
to.description: A phone number, a phone JID, a LID, or a group @g.us JID.

list_groups.name: List groups
list_groups.description: Returns every WhatsApp group the linked account belongs to, with its JID, name, and settings.

reject_call.name: Reject call
reject_call.description: Declines an incoming WhatsApp call reported by a whatsapp_call_update event.

from.name: Caller
from.description: The from value of the whatsapp_call_update event: the caller's phone JID or LID.

get_contacts.name: Get contacts
get_contacts.description: Fetches saved contacts from a fresh WhatsApp app-state snapshot, including names and LIDs when supplied. Returns the original contact fields. Requires response_variable.

make_call.name: Make a voice call
make_call.description: Call a WhatsApp user and connect them to the selected Home Assistant OpenAI agent.

to.name: Recipient
to.description: A WhatsApp phone number, phone JID, or LID. Direct audio calls only.

message.name: Opening message
message.description: Optional opening message to say after the recipient answers (up to 300 characters).

hang_up.name: Hang up a voice call
hang_up.description: End the active voice call without disconnecting WhatsApp messaging.

get_inbox.name: Get message inbox
get_inbox.description: Inspect the next eligible message, queue counts and held messages needing review.

start_inbox_message.name: Start inbox message
start_inbox_message.description: Atomically claims a pending message. Continue the automation only when the response has started=true. Requires response_variable.

inbox.name: Inbox reference
inbox.description: The complete inbox object from the incoming event or Get message inbox response.

complete_inbox_message.name: Complete inbox message
complete_inbox_message.description: Acknowledges a started message after processing and its reply finish. Releases the next pending message.

inbox.name: Inbox reference
inbox.description: The complete inbox object from the incoming event or Get message inbox response.

resolve_inbox_message.name: Resolve inbox message
resolve_inbox_message.description: Retry or discard a pending or held message after inspection, or hold a started message for review after a workflow failure.

inbox.name: Inbox reference
inbox.description: The complete inbox object from the incoming event or Get message inbox response.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Retry after checking whether actions already ran; discard skips the message; hold retains a started message for review and does not cancel running actions.

resolve_inbox_messages.name: Resolve held inbox messages
resolve_inbox_messages.description: Retry or discard matching held messages in one operation. Choose an account, a reason, or both. Active processing and ordinary pending messages are excluded. Check whether actions already ran before retrying.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Retry matching held messages with new receipts, or discard them and release their media.

reason.name: Hold reason
reason.description: Only resolve held messages with this reason. Required unless an account ID is supplied.

client_id.name: Account ID
client_id.description: Only resolve held messages for this account. Disabled accounts can be discarded but cannot be retried.

recover_inbox.name: Recover message inbox
recover_inbox.description: Reload failed inbox storage. Reset archives unreadable state and starts a fresh inbox; archived messages will not be processed automatically. Healthy inboxes are left running.

mode.name: Recovery mode
mode.description: Reload retries loading the existing state. Reset also archives invalid state if it cannot be loaded. Check automation traces and create an app backup before resetting.

inbox_disabled.message: Enable inbox_clients in the WhatsApp app and reload the integration first.

addon_too_old.message: The installed WhatsApp app does not support this action. Update the app and try again.

api_request_failed.message: The WhatsApp app could not complete {action} (error: {error_code}).

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the WhatsApp app while running {action}.

client_disconnected.message: The selected WhatsApp client is disconnected. Connect it before running {action}.

client_not_found.message: The selected WhatsApp client ID does not exist.

invalid_call_reference.message: Enter the callId and from values of a whatsapp_call_update event. from must be the caller's phone JID or LID, not a phone number or group.

invalid_group_target.message: Enter a WhatsApp group JID ending in @g.us, such as the key.remoteJid of a received group message. Phone numbers, LIDs, and broadcasts are not groups.

invalid_profile_target.message: Enter a phone number, a phone JID ending in @s.whatsapp.net, a LID ending in @lid, or a group JID ending in @g.us. Device JIDs and broadcasts are not supported.

invalid_phone_target.message: Enter an international phone number using 5 to 15 digits, optionally prefixed with +, or its @s.whatsapp.net JID. Groups, broadcasts, LIDs, and device JIDs are not supported.

invalid_api_token_config.message: The WhatsApp app supplied an invalid internal credential. Restart the WhatsApp app to refresh its discovery information.

invalid_request.message: The WhatsApp app rejected the action input.

not_configured.message: Set up the WhatsApp integration before calling this action.

number_not_found.message: The recipient phone number is not registered with WhatsApp.

rate_limited.message: Too many WhatsApp lookups were requested. Wait before trying again.

unauthorized.message: WhatsApp app API authorization failed while running {action}. Restart the WhatsApp app to refresh its discovery information.

upstream_error.message: WhatsApp could not complete {action}. Try again later.

invalid_voice_target.message: Enter a WhatsApp phone number, phone JID, or LID for a direct audio call.

inbox_filter_required.message: Choose an account ID, a hold reason, or both before resolving held inbox messages.
